reference: theta--beta--Mach relation and Rankine--Hugoniot jump conditions, Anderson, Modern Compressible Flow, 3rd ed., ch. 3-4; all values recomputed here, none transcribed

assumptions.front: straight, angle beta to the x axis
assumptions.branch: weak = selected in wedge flow; strong = non-unique, needs downstream back pressure

limit_checks.name: theta_zero_weak_degenerates_to_mach_line
limit_checks.statement: theta -> 0 on the weak branch collapses onto the Mach line: beta -> mu = asin(1/M) with no jump (normal Mach -> 1 rejected)
limit_checks.criterion: beta - mu at theta = 1e-6 deg is < 1e-4 deg, the approach is linear (ratio 10 +/- 0.5 when theta drops by 10) and oblique_shock(M, mu) raises

limit_checks.name: theta_zero_strong_degenerates_to_normal_shock
limit_checks.statement: theta -> 0 on the strong branch collapses onto beta = 90 deg with the 1-D normal-shock ratios of the same M
limit_checks.criterion: |90 - beta(theta=1e-6)| < 1e-2 deg and RH ratios match the 1-D closed form to 1e-6 relative

limit_checks.name: theta_max_merges_the_two_branches
limit_checks.statement: the weak and strong roots coincide at the detachment angle: the branch gap shrinks monotonically as theta -> theta_max and dtheta/dbeta vanishes there
limit_checks.criterion: |theta(beta_det) - theta_max| < 1e-9 deg, |dtheta/dbeta| < 1e-4, branch gap decreasing in theta_max - theta

limit_checks.name: branch_continuity_and_ordering
limit_checks.statement: weak and strong roots are distinct and correctly ordered for every theta < theta_max, both stay inside (mu, 90); the weak root increases with the deflection while the strong root decreases from 90 deg (normal shock) to beta_detached
limit_checks.criterion: weak < strong, weak increasing and strong decreasing in theta, roots in (mu, 90)

limit_checks.name: jump_closure_on_both_branches
limit_checks.statement: every anchor state pair satisfies the four Rankine--Hugoniot jump conditions and the velocity-vector deflection equals the theta--beta--Mach deflection
limit_checks.criterion: max RH residual < 1e-12, max |theta_vectors - theta| < 1e-9 deg
